alt.en: Tall painted wooden carving with a large toothed head above smaller interlocking figures; worn red, white and dark surfaces remain visible.
alt.zh: 高挑的彩绘木雕，露齿的大头下方连接较小的人物形体；表面可见磨损的红、白与深色颜料。

caption.en: New Ireland, 1800s. Painted wood and sea-snail opercula, 92.7 cm high. Cleveland Museum of Art, 1971.149; gift of Dr. and Mrs. Thomas Munro.
caption.zh: 新爱尔兰，19世纪。彩绘木材与海螺厣，高92.7厘米。克利夫兰艺术博物馆，1971.149；托马斯·芒罗夫妇捐赠。

interpretation.en: The carved forms rise in an openwork column. The museum places such commissioned carvings within memorial festivals involving feasting, speeches, dance and exchanges; their ceremonial life extended beyond the surviving wood.
interpretation.zh: 雕刻形体组成透空的立柱。博物馆将这类受委托制作的雕刻置于包含宴饮、演说、舞蹈与交换的纪念仪式中；存世木雕只是其仪式生命的一部分。

title.en: An allegory for a Westphalian negotiator
title.zh: 献给威斯特伐利亚和约谈判者的寓意画

alt.en: Black-chalk drawing of classical figures in a columned hall, with figures on clouds holding a blank oval frame and an armored figure near a doorway.
alt.zh: 黑色粉笔画：古典人物置身柱廊大厅；云上人物托起空白椭圆框，门旁有披甲人物。

caption.en: Grégoire Huret, Allegory in Honor of Claude de Mesmes, Count d’Avaux, c. 1648–49. Black chalk, 30.1 × 38 cm. Cleveland Museum of Art, 2016.36, Delia E. Holden Fund.
caption.zh: 格雷瓜尔·于雷，《献给阿沃伯爵克洛德·德·梅姆的寓意画》，约1648—1649年。黑色粉笔，30.1×38厘米。克利夫兰艺术博物馆，2016.36，Delia E. Holden基金购藏。

interpretation.en: D’Avaux helped negotiate for France at Westphalia. Huret celebrates diplomacy through classical allegory, not a witnessed signing scene. The oval left blank in this preparatory drawing held the diplomat’s portrait in the finished engraving.
interpretation.zh: 阿沃伯爵曾代表法国参与威斯特伐利亚谈判。于雷借古典寓意颂扬外交，而非描绘亲见的签约场景。这幅准备稿中留白的椭圆框，在完成的版画中放入了外交官肖像。

alt.en: Nyerere stands at right in a long dark coat, turned toward Prince Bernhard at left; uniformed honor guards line the airfield behind them.
alt.zh: 尼雷尔身穿深色长外套站在右侧，转身面向左侧的伯恩哈德亲王；身后机场上排列着仪仗队。

caption.en: Eric Koch / Anefo, 21 April 1965. Tanzania’s president Julius Nyerere and Prince Bernhard after inspecting the honor guard at Soesterberg airfield. Nationaal Archief, 917-6692.
caption.zh: 埃里克·科赫／Anefo，1965年4月21日。坦桑尼亚总统朱利叶斯·尼雷尔与伯恩哈德亲王在苏斯特贝赫机场检阅仪仗队后。荷兰国家档案馆，917-6692。

interpretation.en: The state-visit photograph records Nyerere’s diplomacy abroad. The formal greeting and honor guard make the ceremony visible; it was photographed in 1965, a year after Tanganyika and Zanzibar united.
interpretation.zh: 这张国事访问照片记录尼雷尔的对外交往。正式迎接与仪仗队呈现了外交礼仪；拍摄于1965年，即坦噶尼喀与桑给巴尔联合之后一年。

title.en: Miriam Makeba beside a dressing-room mirror
title.zh: 化妆镜旁的米丽娅姆·马凯巴

alt.en: Makeba, wearing a tall headwrap and patterned dress, turns toward the camera beside a mirror that reflects her profile and a guitarist.
alt.zh: 马凯巴戴着高头巾、身穿花纹连衣裙，在镜旁回头望向相机；镜中映出她的侧影与一名吉他手。

caption.en: Miriam Makeba, 7 March 1969. Photographer unrecorded / Anefo; the archive associates the photograph with the Grand Gala du Disque Populaire. Nationaal Archief, 922-1835.
caption.zh: 米丽娅姆·马凯巴，1969年3月7日。摄影者未载／Anefo；档案将照片关联于Grand Gala du Disque Populaire音乐晚会。荷兰国家档案馆，922-1835。

interpretation.en: The mirror places performer, costume and musician in one frame. This is a moment in Makeba’s international performing life, not an image of her political speeches or her later return to South Africa.
interpretation.zh: 镜面把表演者、服装与乐手纳入同一画面。这记录了马凯巴国际演出生涯中的一刻，并非她发表政治演说或后来返回南非的场景。

title.zh: 1974年桑戈尔国事访问阿姆斯特丹

alt.en: Senghor walks in a dark suit beside Queen Juliana, with officers behind them and a line of rifle-bearing honor guards to the right.
alt.zh: 桑戈尔身穿深色西装，与朱丽安娜女王并肩行走；身后是军官，右侧列队的仪仗队持步枪致敬。

caption.en: Bert Verhoeff / Anefo, 22 October 1974. Léopold Sédar Senghor and Queen Juliana inspect the honor guard outside the Royal Palace on Dam Square, Amsterdam. Nationaal Archief, 927-5335.
caption.zh: 贝尔特·费尔胡夫／Anefo，1974年10月22日。莱奥波尔德·塞达尔·桑戈尔与朱丽安娜女王在阿姆斯特丹水坝广场王宫外检阅仪仗队。荷兰国家档案馆，927-5335。

interpretation.en: Senegal’s poet-president appears here as a visiting head of state. The ceremonial photograph records his diplomatic role in 1974, fourteen years after independence; it does not depict independence itself or the creation of Négritude.
interpretation.zh: 塞内加尔的诗人总统在这里以到访国家元首的身份出现。这张礼仪照片记录独立十四年后、1974年的外交活动，并非独立时刻或“黑人性”思想形成的场景。
